import json, os, subprocess, sys
SUB='/app/submission/ipv6_replay.py'
W='/workspace/tmp/t6'; os.makedirs(W, exist_ok=True)
mp=os.path.join(W,'m.json')
json.dump({"version":1,"seed":1,"low_count":1,"attempts":1,"spacing_ms":1,"timeout_ms":10,
           "windows":[{"id":"w","start_ms":0,"scopes":[{"id":"s","prefix":"2001:db8::/64","subnets":[0]}]}]}, open(mp,'w'))
def run(data, name):
    p=os.path.join(W,name); open(p,'wb').write(data)
    r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,SUB,'replay',mp,p],capture_output=True,timeout=200)
    return r
row=b'{"probe_id":"w/s/0/low-1/0","received_ms":1,"target":"2001:db8::1","source":"2001:db8::1","type":129,"code":0}'
print('row len', len(row))
# 300000 lines, trailing LF
r=run(b'\n'.join([row]*300000)+b'\n','a.jsonl'); print('300000 with LF:', r.returncode, json.loads(r.stdout)['duplicate_rows'] if r.returncode==0 else r.stderr[:80])
# 300000 lines, no trailing LF
r=run(b'\n'.join([row]*300000),'b.jsonl'); print('300000 no LF:', r.returncode, (json.loads(r.stdout)['duplicate_rows'], len(json.loads(r.stdout)['diagnostics'])) if r.returncode==0 else r.stderr[:80])
# 300001 lines, no trailing LF
r=run(b'\n'.join([row]*300001),'c.jsonl'); print('300001 no LF:', r.returncode, r.stdout[:20], r.stderr[:60])
EOF
